instructions: Select one ordinary mouse or keyboard input from the current screenshot. Pointer locations are supplied by native Box questions; dragging supplies start and end locations. Control names below label functions, not keyboard key names; use the exact keys stated in their descriptions for a control action. For JSON actions, control duration is 0.05..3 seconds, drag duration is 0.1..2 seconds, and wait seconds is 0.1..5. Frozen execution may further cap input duration to its configured step.

right_click.description: Right-click a visible screen target to cancel or use its ordinary context action.

drag.description: Hold the left mouse button and drag between two visible locations, including a rectangular tool selection.

dig.description: Press g to select the Dig tool.

cancel.description: Press Escape to dismiss the current tool or open the pause menu.

pause.description: Press space to toggle the native simulation pause.

camera_up.description: Press w to move the camera upward.

camera_left.description: Press a to move the camera left.

camera_down.description: Press s to move the camera downward.

camera_right.description: Press d to move the camera right.

zoom_in.description: Scroll the mouse wheel up by one step.

zoom_out.description: Scroll the mouse wheel down by one step.

cycle_speed.description: Press Tab to cycle the native simulation speed through its three settings.
